source_metadata.title: Optic nerve aplasia: A case series

duplicate_review.notes: Figure captions were reconciled against text but not duplicated as separate atoms where they repeated case findings.

extraction_limitations: This is a three-case descriptive case series; the source contains no comparator group or inferential treatment-effect analysis.
The article does not provide a dedicated methods section or explicit study limitations section.
Background statements summarizing prior literature were not converted into primary-study result atoms.
schema_gaps: The current LiteratureAtom quantitative_result kind requires population, exposures, outcome, and quantitative_result. Case-series measurements such as visual acuity, intraocular pressure, axial length, and exophthalmometry have no intervention/exposure, so they were preserved as qualitative_result atoms with numeric values in canonical_statement rather than forced into quantitative_result.
